title: asplenium scolopendrium subsp. japonicum
intro: Asplenium scolopendrium subsp. japonicum, commonly known as Japanese maidenhair fern, is a subspecies of the Asplenium scolopendrium plant, belonging to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Japanese maidenhair fern are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which work to calm and soothe the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
